title: Access file
description: Who may call the operations of one target deployable with a workload token, and whether the target holds protected writes (ADR 0040, ADR 0050, ADR 0058). The file is access/<target slug>.yaml, and the target's team owns it. Identity issues a workload token for a caller and a target with the operationId of each operation that lists the caller, and it refuses a pair that no operation lists. Identity and Organization Access install minimum authority versions in every target that sets protected_writes (ADR 0068).

protected_writes.description: True when the target is a registered domain service: it holds protected writes, checks them against minimum authority versions in its commits, and serves installMinimumAuthorityVersion.

operations.description: Each operation that a workload token may permit, keyed by its operationId in the target's contract or in a shared contract that the target serves. An operation that is not listed cannot be called with a workload token.

installMinimumAuthorityVersion.description: Only Identity and Organization Access install minimum authority versions (ADR 0068).
Identity installs the minimum of a principal in every registered domain service (ADR 0050).

operationId.description: An operationId of OpenAPI, in lower camel case.

callers.description: The slugs of the deployables that may call the operation.
